sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日商业与政策通讯

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《Dealbook》的报道。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导者，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼，以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The story of how the nation's largest public school system defied the odds to reopen for in-person classes, then promptly shut down again after just eight weeks.
sentences.zh: 全美最大的公立学校系统如何顶住压力重新开放面授课程，却在仅仅八周后又迅速关停的故事。

sentences.en: My colleague,
sentences.zh: 我的同事

sentences.en: Eliza Shapiro, on the lessons from New York's experience.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎·夏皮罗将为我们讲述纽约经验中的教训。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月23日，星期一。

sentences.en: Eliza, I wonder if you can describe for me the experience of being a New York City public school parent or teacher or administrator over the past few weeks.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎，我想请你描述一下，在过去几周里，作为纽约市公立学校的家长、老师或管理者是什么体验。

sentences.en: So, and now to the coronavirus pandemic, all eyes on New York City schools.
sentences.zh: 那么，现在转向冠状病毒大流行，所有人的目光都聚焦在纽约市的学校上。

sentences.en: Every morning for the last few weeks in New York City, hundreds of thousands of people, parents,
sentences.zh: 在纽约市过去的几周里，每天早晨，成千上万的人，包括家长、

sentences.en: teachers, kids, politicians have been engaged in this very intense, unusual ritual of rushing their
sentences.zh: 老师、孩子和政客们，都在进行一种非常紧张、不同寻常的仪式：每天早晨一睁眼就冲向电脑或拿起手机，

sentences.en: computers or picking up their phones every morning and frantically checking Twitter or the news to see if today was the day we were going to hit this reviled number, three percent.
sentences.zh: 疯狂地刷推特或新闻，看今天是不是我们会达到那个遭人唾弃的数字——百分之三的日子。

sentences.en: And when we hit that, schools will close.
sentences.zh: 一旦达到这个数字，学校就会关闭。

sentences.en: But for right now, they remain open.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，它们仍然开放。

sentences.en: And tell me about that number of three percent.
sentences.zh: 能跟我讲讲百分之三这个数字吗？

sentences.en: So, three percent is the average number of coronavirus tests that come back positive across New York City over a seven-day period.
sentences.zh: 好的，百分之三是指在七天内，纽约市冠状病毒检测结果呈阳性的平均比例。

sentences.en: So, once we hit that number, the entire school system shuts down.
sentences.zh: 所以，一旦我们达到这个数字，整个学校系统就会关闭。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, no wiggle room.
sentences.zh: 也就是说没有回旋的余地。

sentences.en: Three percent closed.
sentences.zh: 达到百分之三就关闭。

sentences.en: No wiggle room.
sentences.zh: 没有回旋余地。

sentences.en: New York City is moving closer and closer to closing its schools.
sentences.zh: 纽约市正越来越接近关闭学校。

sentences.en: And it now stands at 2.57 percent.
sentences.zh: 目前这一比例为2.57%。

sentences.en: 2.6 percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之二点六。

sentences.en: Inching closer.
sentences.zh: 步步逼近。

sentences.en: 2.83 percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之二点八三。

sentences.en: Less than two-tenths of a point from the shutdown trigger.
sentences.zh: 距离触发关闭机制只差不到千分之二。

sentences.en: Three percent could be right around the corner.
sentences.zh: 百分之三可能就在眼前。

sentences.en: The question is whether New York City's Department of Education is ready to go all remote once schools are closed.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，纽约市教育部是否准备好在学校关闭后全面转为远程教学。

sentences.en: And last Wednesday morning, we woke up and we realized that we'd hit exactly 3.00 percent on the dot.
sentences.zh: 上周三早上，我们醒来后发现，阳性率正好达到了3.00%。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, as of today, on our seven-day rolling average for coronavirus positivity in New York City has hit exactly 3.0 percent.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，截至今天，我们在纽约市的七天滚动平均冠状病毒阳性率已经正好达到了3.0%。

sentences.en: And as a result, we do need to close our schools for the coming days.
sentences.zh: 因此，接下来的几天我们确实需要关闭学校。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, hundreds of thousands of parents and educators just kind of felt like the rug had been ripped out from under them.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，成千上万的家长和教育工作者感觉就像脚下的地毯被人猛地抽走了一样。

sentences.en: The risk of spread in schools is low, and the harm that we are doing to our children is high.
sentences.zh: 学校传播病毒的风险很低，而我们对孩子造成的伤害却很大。

sentences.en: I am sick as a working mom of waiting, checking Twitter to see if schools are going to be open
sentences.zh: 作为一个上班族的妈妈，我厌倦了无休止的等待，不停地刷推特看明天学校是否开学，

sentences.en: tomorrow and how to juggle my work responsibilities and tell my daughter again to buck up.
sentences.zh: 以及如何平衡工作职责，并再次告诉女儿要坚强。

sentences.en: She should be grateful for one to two days of school a week.
sentences.zh: 她应该为一周能去学校一到两天感到庆幸。

sentences.en: It's time to get our kids back in school now.
sentences.zh: 现在是时候让我们的孩子重返学校了。

sentences.en: There is school safe!
sentences.zh: 学校是安全的！

sentences.en: Schools are safe!
sentences.zh: 学校是安全的！

sentences.en: Schools are safe!
sentences.zh: 学校是安全的！

sentences.en: Schools are safe!
sentences.zh: 学校是安全的！

sentences.en: So Eliza, how did we get to this moment of such frustration?
sentences.zh: 那么伊丽莎，我们是怎么走到这种充满挫败感的时刻的？

sentences.en: I mean, how did it come to be that an entire learning system rode on a single number, like three percent?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为什么整个教育系统竟然维系在一个单一的数字上，比如百分之三？

sentences.en: How is it that we arrived at that pretty peculiar situation?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么会陷入如此奇特的局面？

sentences.en: So let me take you back to the summer.
sentences.zh: 让我带你回到夏天。

sentences.en: New York City was just coming out of this unbelievably horrific, traumatic, bleak period where we were the global epicenter of the virus.
sentences.zh: 当时纽约市刚刚走出一段令人难以置信的恐怖、痛苦和暗淡的时期，我们曾是全球病毒的震中。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, by late June, early July, I mean, the city was really, really turning a corner.
sentences.zh: 然后到了6月下旬、7月初，我的意思是，这座城市真的在好转。

sentences.en: The numbers were getting so much better, and people were filling up parks and beaches and responsibly hanging out outside.
sentences.zh: 数据变得好多了，人们纷纷涌向公园和海滩，在户外负责任地聚会。

sentences.en: And the city just felt like it was on the mend.
sentences.zh: 这座城市感觉正在恢复元气。

sentences.en: And so immediately, people's first thought and the mayor's first thought goes to schools.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们和市长的第一个念头立刻转向了学校。

sentences.en: You know, can we actually get this massive public school system open in a few months in the fall if we are, in fact, turning a corner as a city?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我们这座城市确实在好转，我们能在几个月后的秋天重新开放这个庞大的公立学校系统吗？

sentences.en: New Yorkers have achieved so much together over the last few months.
sentences.zh: 过去几个月里，纽约人一起取得了巨大的成就。

sentences.en: So, pretty early in the summer, Mayor Bill de Blasio comes out and says, I am going to do this incredibly hard thing.
sentences.zh: 所以在夏天很早的时候，市长比尔·德布拉西奥站出来说，我要做一件极其艰难的事。

sentences.en: And that's reopening our schools.
sentences.zh: 那就是重新开放我们的学校。

sentences.en: Reopen the public schools.
sentences.zh: 重新开放公立学校。

sentences.en: We need to help our kids begin.
sentences.zh: 我们需要帮助孩子们重新开始。

sentences.en: So he sort of spends a bunch of the summer making a moral case for reopening schools.
sentences.zh: 所以他在整个夏天花了很多时间为重新开学寻找道德依据。

sentences.en: What do you mean a moral case?
sentences.zh: 你指的道德依据是什么？

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们这就来看看。

sentences.en: So not long after the mayor said he wanted to get these schools open.
sentences.zh: 市长表达了想要开放学校的想法后不久。

sentences.en: He was going to get these schools open.
sentences.zh: 他就要让这些学校开学。

sentences.en: I got to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 我有机会跟他谈了谈。

sentences.en: I wanted to ask him why this was so important for him, why he was so intent on reopening this massive, sprawling, complicated school system.
sentences.zh: 我想问他为什么这对他是如此重要，为什么他如此坚决地要重新开放这个庞大、错综复杂、枝节横生的学校系统。

sentences.en: Hello, sir.
sentences.zh: 你好，先生。

sentences.en: I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Oh, it is nice and cool in this class.
sentences.zh: 哦，这个教室里真凉爽。

sentences.en: So we met in the northern end of the Bronx in a big, empty public high school where there were a bunch of custodians sort of jamming open windows to
sentences.zh: 于是我们在布朗克斯区北部的一所大型空置公立高中见面了，那里有一群工友正在把窗户撬开，

sentences.en: improve ventilation and get fresh air in, windows that in some cases seem to have not been open for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 以改善通风并引入新鲜空气，有些窗户看起来已经很久没有打开过了。

sentences.en: And we kind of folded ourselves into these little desks.
sentences.zh: 我们局促地坐在这些小课桌旁。

sentences.en: He's super tall.
sentences.zh: 他个子超级高。

sentences.en: So he sort of had to squeeze himself in there.
sentences.zh: 所以他不得不把自己塞进去。

sentences.en: We sat six feet apart.
sentences.zh: 我们保持六英尺的距离坐着。

sentences.en: And I asked him, you know, tell me why this is so important to you.
sentences.zh: 我问他，你知道的，告诉我为什么这对你如此重要。

sentences.en: What does school reopening mean to you for the city?
sentences.zh: 重新开学对这座城市意味着什么？

sentences.en: Could you ask a simpler first question?
sentences.zh: 你就不能问一个简单点儿的第一个问题吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: What you have to understand about Bill de Blasio is he came into office promising to be kind of the education mayor.
sentences.zh: 关于比尔·德布拉西奥，你必须理解的是，他上任时承诺要成为所谓的“教育市长”。

sentences.en: He has always said that education is his top priority, that reducing inequality in the public school system is his sort of biggest task.
sentences.zh: 他一直说教育是他的首要任务，减少公立学校系统的不平等是他最重要的任务。

sentences.en: He also genuinely believes that schools should be open.
sentences.zh: 他也真心相信学校应该开学。

sentences.en: They need this.
sentences.zh: 他们需要这个。

sentences.en: I think the simplest thing to say to begin is they need this.
sentences.zh: 我想最简单的一句话就是，他们需要这个。

sentences.en: It's not optional to them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说不是可有可无的。

sentences.en: And what he said is he sort of made the case for why in-person is so important and why he thought families needed the option of going back into classroom.
sentences.zh: 他说的话阐述了为什么面对面上课如此重要，以及为什么他认为家庭需要有回到教室的选择权。

sentences.en: I think much more deeply, there is an inequality that attends to remote learning.
sentences.zh: 我认为更深层次的是，远程学习伴随着一种不平等。

sentences.en: He also talked about the costs of keeping schools closed.
sentences.zh: 他还谈到了保持学校关闭的代价。

sentences.en: I mean, the vast majority of students who go to New York City public schools are low income.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，去纽约市公立学校上学的绝大多数学生都是低收入群体。

sentences.en: There are over 100,000 homeless students.
sentences.zh: 有超过10万名无家可归的学生。

sentences.en: There are 200,000 students with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 有20万名残疾学生。

sentences.en: I mean, the scale of need in this public school system is unlike anything else in the country.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个公立学校系统的需求规模是全国任何其他地方都无法比拟的。

sentences.en: You might not get the health care or mental health care or dental care or laundry services, in some cases, that you can get in a public school system.
sentences.zh: 你在公立学校系统里能获得的医疗保健、心理健康护理、牙科护理或洗衣服务，在其他地方可能都得不到。

sentences.en: Schools are places where abuse is spotted.
sentences.zh: 学校是能够发现虐待行为的地方。

sentences.en: And without kids actually showing up to the door every day and teachers asking what's going on at home
sentences.zh: 如果没有孩子每天出现在门口，没有老师询问家里发生了什么，

sentences.en: or being able to see that something is wrong, that's a potentially really dangerous situation.
sentences.zh: 或者无法察觉出不对劲，那可能是一个非常危险的情况。

sentences.en: There's so many things happening here, so many things riding on this decision.
sentences.zh: 这里有太多事情在发生，太多事情压在这个决定上了。

sentences.en: And then he also told me, look around us, look at New York City right now.
sentences.zh: 然后他还对我说，看看我们的周围，看看现在的纽约市。

sentences.en: This city has been heroic.
sentences.zh: 这座城市太英勇了。

sentences.en: The people of this city really have been heroic.
sentences.zh: 这座城市的人民确实太英勇了。

sentences.en: We're the envy of the country.
sentences.zh: 我们是全国艳羡的对象。

sentences.en: We have these incredibly low positivity rates.
sentences.zh: 我们的阳性率低得不可思议。

sentences.en: And he said, if any place can do it, we're the place that can do it.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果有什么地方能做到这一点，我们就是那个能做到的地方。

sentences.en: You know, I would much rather be criticized for we tried, even if it didn't work out the way we hoped, than we didn't have the courage to try.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比起没有勇气去尝试，我宁愿因为我们尝试过却没有达到预期而受到批评。

sentences.en: So you're not planning to delay the storm?
sentences.zh: 所以你并不打算推迟风暴？

sentences.en: I have a very clear plan.
sentences.zh: 我有非常明确的计划。

sentences.en: And I'll always listen to concerns.
sentences.zh: 我总是会倾听各方的担忧。

sentences.en: I'll watch the health care situation.
sentences.zh: 我会关注医疗卫生状况。

sentences.en: I'll listen to substantive issues and people raise them.
sentences.zh: 当人们提出实质性问题时，我会倾听。

sentences.en: But the plan is the plan.
sentences.zh: 但计划就是计划。

sentences.en: So now that the mayor has laid out his argument for doing this, how does he actually start to reopen the system?
sentences.zh: 既然市长已经阐述了他这样做的理由，他是如何真正开始重新开放这个系统的呢？

sentences.en: So very quickly after the mayor says he wants to get schools open, it becomes clear that this is basically the hardest thing he's ever tried to do as mayor.
sentences.zh: 因此，在市长表示希望开放学校后不久，人们就清楚地发现，这基本上是他担任市长以来尝试过的最难的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, the sort of logistics of it are just dizzying.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其中的物流后勤简直让人头晕目眩。

sentences.en: The tasks start piling up day after day, hour after hour.
sentences.zh: 各种任务日复一日、时时刻刻地堆积起来。

sentences.en: One of the biggest immediate tasks was that the mayor gave kids and families a choice of whether they wanted to come back into classrooms or not.
sentences.zh: 最迫切的任务之一就是，市长让孩子和家长选择是否要回到教室上课。

sentences.en: So all of a sudden the city had to create two school systems out of one, one for the kids who were going to be home and one for the kids who
sentences.zh: 因此，这座城市突然不得不从一个学校系统中分化出两个系统，一个给呆在家里的孩子，另一个给

sentences.en: are going to be back in the classroom at least part of the week so that they could rotate in and out for social distancing.
sentences.zh: 至少一周部分时间返回教室的孩子，以便他们可以轮流进出以保持社交距离。

sentences.en: So that's one whole logistical nightmare.
sentences.zh: 所以这简直是一场后勤噩梦。

sentences.en: And then there's just actually getting the school buildings ready, which is an absolute enormous undertaking.
sentences.zh: 然后就是实际让校舍准备就绪，这是一项绝对庞大的任务。

sentences.en: New York City has well over a thousand school buildings.
sentences.zh: 纽约市有一千多所校舍。

sentences.en: Many of them are over a century old.
sentences.zh: 其中许多已有上百年历史。

sentences.en: They have windows that don't open.
sentences.zh: 它们的窗户打不开。

sentences.en: They have HVACs that have been broken for years.
sentences.zh: 它们的暖通空调系统已经坏了多年。

sentences.en: They have radiators and heating systems that maybe have never worked.
sentences.zh: 它们的散热器和供暖系统可能从来没用过。

sentences.en: And you had to basically transform what New York City classrooms look like.
sentences.zh: 你基本上必须彻底改造纽约市教室的面貌。

sentences.en: Desks are spaced six feet apart.
sentences.zh: 课桌之间保持六英尺的距离。

sentences.en: The city has to find personal protective equipment for kids and teachers and nurses and everyone in the building.
sentences.zh: 这座城市必须为儿童、老师、护士以及大楼里的每个人寻找个人防护装备。

sentences.en: They have to get, you know, more Clorox wipes than you know existed.
sentences.zh: 他们必须弄到，你知道的，比你想象中还要多的高乐氏（Clorox）消毒湿巾。

sentences.en: Masks, gloves, spray, face shields.
sentences.zh: 口罩、手套、喷雾、面罩。

sentences.en: I mean, every piece of cleaning equipment you can think of, these schools needed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你能想到的每一件清洁设备，这些学校都需要。

sentences.en: And they needed them really quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且他们需要得非常快。

sentences.en: Because remember, the city basically gave itself two months to pull off essentially the hardest logistical task in decades that this city has tried.
sentences.zh: 因为记住，这座城市基本上只给了自己两个月的时间来完成几十年来这座城市尝试过的最艰难的后勤任务。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So as the mayor starts going through this enormous to-do list, there starts to be a growing resistance against his reopening plan.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着市长开始处理这份庞大的待办事项清单，反对他重新开学计划的阻力也越来越大。

sentences.en: Children cannot focus on school work if their family members and teachers are in the hospital or dying.
sentences.zh: 如果家庭成员和老师正在住院或垂死，孩子们就无法专注于学业。

sentences.en: Children cannot learn if they're dead.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子死了，他们就无法学习。

sentences.en: Many teachers saying, we don't feel safe.
sentences.zh: 许多老师说，我们感觉不安全。

sentences.en: We don't think it's right to go back into our hundred-year-old school buildings and teach kids in a mask and just hope that it's safe.
sentences.zh: 我们认为回到我们这一百年历史的校舍里、戴着口罩教孩子们并盲目祈祷它是安全的，这种做法是不对的。

sentences.en: We will not be an experiment.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不当小白鼠。

sentences.en: We will not die so that the economy can get back to work.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会为了让经济恢复运转而付出生命的代价。

sentences.en: So you were seeing big protests near City Hall and in lower Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 当时你在市政厅附近和曼哈顿下城看到了规模宏大的抗议活动。

sentences.en: Teachers were carrying coffins.
sentences.zh: 老师们抬着棺材。

sentences.en: They were saying, we're scared we're going to die.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们害怕自己会死。

sentences.en: I mean, there was this movement where teachers were changing their Twitter handles to say, we won't die for the Department of Education.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当时有这样一场运动，老师们纷纷把自己的推特用户名改成，我们不会为教育部去死。

sentences.en: We won't die for the city of New York.
sentences.zh: 我们不会为纽约市去死。

sentences.en: ...for air at 630 in the morning.
sentences.zh: ……在早晨六点半大口喘着粗气。

sentences.en: And by 630 at night, he was dead without family at his bedside.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上六点半，他已经去世了，身旁没有亲人。

sentences.en: Alone.
sentences.zh: 孤零零一个人。

sentences.en: I don't want to see the teachers in that position.
sentences.zh: 我不想让老师们处于那种境地。

sentences.en: I don't want to see the children in that position.
sentences.zh: 我也不想让孩子们处于那种境地。

sentences.en: And so how does the mayor respond to this?
sentences.zh: 那么市长对此作何回应呢？

sentences.en: I mean, having teachers in the streets saying they're afraid of dying in the classroom seems like a pretty important obstacle.
sentences.zh: 我是说，让老师们走上街头说他们害怕死在教室里，这似乎是一个相当重大的阻碍。

sentences.en: So at the height of this sort of period of resistance and protest and fear and skepticism about the reopening plan, the mayor kind of has to come up with a way...
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个充满抵制、抗议、恐惧以及对重新开学计划持怀疑态度的时期达到顶点时，市长不得不相出一种方法……

sentences.en: Good morning, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: ...of calming people down.
sentences.zh: ……来让大家平静下来。

sentences.en: Well, this morning, we're going to talk about the most important piece of reopening this city, restarting this city.
sentences.zh: 好吧，今天早上，我们要讨论重新开放这座城市、重启这座城市最重要的一环。

sentences.en: And that's starting our schools up again.
sentences.zh: 那就是重新开学。

sentences.en: And so he comes out and he says, okay, folks, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 于是他出来说道，好吧，各位，我听到你们的声音了。

sentences.en: And we understand the anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我们理解这种焦虑。

sentences.en: We understand the fear because this city's been through so much.
sentences.zh: 我们理解这种恐惧，因为这座城市经历了太多的风雨。

sentences.en: And I have a plan to keep you safe.
sentences.zh: 我有一个保障你们安全的计划。

sentences.en: And if it isn't safe, we don't do it.
sentences.zh: 如果不安全，我们就不会去做。

sentences.en: It's as simple as that.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这么简单。

sentences.en: And so he kind of introduces this menu of safety measures.
sentences.zh: 于是他推出了这一系列的安全举措。

sentences.en: So what are we doing?
sentences.zh: 那么我们都在做些什么呢？

sentences.en: You've heard some of it before.
sentences.zh: 你们之前已经听说过一些了。

sentences.en: We're using...
sentences.zh: 我们正在采取……

sentences.en: It's wearing a mask all day.
sentences.zh: 那就是整天佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: It's social distancing.
sentences.zh: 那就是保持社交距离。

sentences.en: Free priority testing.
sentences.zh: 提供免费的优先检测。

sentences.en: It's having a nurse in every school building.
sentences.zh: 那就是在每个学校建筑里配备一名护士。

sentences.en: Making sure that teachers, kids, staff all have the personal protective equipment.
sentences.zh: 确保老师、孩子和员工都拥有个人防护装备。

sentences.en: And then finally, he says...
sentences.zh: 最后，他说……

sentences.en: We will not reopen our schools unless the city infection rate is below 3%.
sentences.zh: 除非城市的感染率低于3%，否则我们不会重新开放学校。

sentences.en: You have my word that I'm going to shut down the whole school system if we ever reach 3% positivity.
sentences.zh: 我向你们保证，如果阳性率达到3%，我将关闭整个学校系统。

sentences.en: Ah, so this is the moment that the 3% rule comes into play.
sentences.zh: 啊，所以这就是3%规则发挥作用的时刻。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And how does the mayor explain how he arrived at that 3% number, what it's based on?
sentences.zh: 那么市长是如何解释他得出3%这个数字的，它是基于什么呢？

sentences.en: So at the time, the number that was kind of floating around there for when your alarm bell should start to go off and when schools and other things may not be safe was 5%.
sentences.zh: 当时，在大家心中，当你的警报钟应该开始敲响、当学校和其他场所可能不再安全时，人们普遍流传的一个数字是5%。

sentences.en: So we're hearing 5% a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以我们经常听到5%这个数字。

sentences.en: And I think basically part of what happened is that the mayor and his team looked at that number and they said to the city, we're going to do you one better.
sentences.zh: 我想这其中部分原因在于，市长和他的团队看到了这个数字，然后对全市人民说，我们要比这个做得更好。

sentences.en: We're going to come in below 5% as a symbol.
sentences.zh: 作为一种象征，我们要把感染率控制在5%以下。

sentences.en: It was a promise.
sentences.zh: 这是一个承诺。

sentences.en: It was a way of saying, I'm going to set the lowest, most conservative threshold that's out there.
sentences.zh: 这是一种表态，即我要设定现存最低、最保守的门槛。

sentences.en: And that is proof that I'm taking school safety really, really seriously in this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这证明了我在这场大流行中极其极其严肃地对待学校安全问题。

sentences.en: And does it work?
sentences.zh: 这管用吗？

sentences.en: Does this 3% number start to assuage the doubts and anxieties of these teachers, of these parents?
sentences.zh: 这个3%的数字开始平息这些老师和家长的疑虑和焦虑了吗？

sentences.en: So I think in combination with some other safety measures that teachers were fighting for, we begin to see a way, a path to reopening.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，结合老师们一直在争取的一些其他安全措施，我们开始看到一条通往重新开学的道路。

sentences.en: The deaths are being rearranged, the masks and the Clorox wipes are coming in.
sentences.zh: 课桌被重新摆放，口罩和高乐氏消毒湿巾也送到了。

sentences.en: And we're so far from 3% at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时我们距离3%还很远。

sentences.en: I mean, we have days where we're under 1% that it seems like, oh, we are in good shape.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们有几天甚至低于1%，以至于看起来，哦，我们状态大好。

sentences.en: And sure enough, in late September, they opened the doors of the school buildings.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，在9月下旬，他们打开了校门。

sentences.en: I love your mask.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢你的口罩。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, for the first time since early March, you saw kids with backpacks walking into schools.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，自3月初以来，你第一次看到背着书包的孩子们走进学校。

sentences.en: Love you, Mom.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，再见。

sentences.en: Morning.
sentences.zh: 早安。

sentences.en: That was good.
sentences.zh: 真不错。

sentences.en: Morning.
sentences.zh: 早安。

sentences.en: They had their masks on, but they were so clearly delighted to be there.
sentences.zh: 他们戴着口罩，但很明显，他们为能来到这里感到高兴。

sentences.en: And actually, for about eight weeks, it seems to be going pretty well.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在大约八周的时间里，一切似乎进展得相当顺利。

sentences.en: More and more parents are coming out and saying, God, my kid is happier than they've been in a long time.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的家长出来说，天哪，我的孩子比很长一段时间以来的任何时候都要快乐。

sentences.en: And more and more teachers, including many teachers who were really, really concerned about safety over the summer, are saying,
sentences.zh: 越来越多的老师，包括许多在夏天时对安全性感到非常非常担忧的老师，都在说，

sentences.en: I feel like I'm making so much progress because we're in person.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我取得了很大的进展，因为我们在进行面授教学。

sentences.en: And yes, this is not easy, but something here is working.
sentences.zh: 是的，这并不容易，但这里的某些做法确实奏效了。

sentences.en: And I think it was a very proud moment for the mayor, but it didn't last very long.
sentences.zh: 我想这对市长来说是一个非常值得骄傲的时刻，但它并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: After about, you know, a few weeks back in the classroom, we begin to see the numbers slowly, slowly, slowly, but steadily tick up.
sentences.zh: 在回到教室大约几周后，我们开始看到数字缓慢、缓慢、缓慢但稳定地上升。

sentences.en: And no longer are we hovering around 1%, but we're getting to 1.5% and sometimes we're getting to 2%.
sentences.zh: 我们不再徘徊在1%左右，而是达到了1.5%，有时甚至达到了2%。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, everyone is like, wait, remember the 3% thing that we haven't talked about for weeks or months because the city's been doing so well?
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，所有人都觉得，等等，还记得那个我们已经几个星期甚至几个月没谈论过的3%的规定吗，因为之前这座城市表现得太好了？

sentences.en: That number is kind of in our sights.
sentences.zh: 那个数字现在有点进入我们的视线了。

sentences.en: But just to be clear, even as this number of the citywide coronavirus positivity rate is starting to creep up, inside these schools, does it remain safe?
sentences.zh: 但需要明确的是，即使全市范围内的冠状病毒阳性率开始攀升，在这些学校内部，它仍然是安全的吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, the mayor is surprised, actually, pleasantly surprised by how safe the schools are.
sentences.zh: 我是说，市长甚至感到惊讶，对学校的安全性感到欣喜的惊讶。

sentences.en: At one point, one of his top public health officials said public schools are among the safest places to be in New York City, you know, outside of your own home.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他的一位顶级公共卫生官员表示，公共学校是纽约市最安全的地方之一，你知道的，除了你自己的家以外。

sentences.en: But the school system is not going to shut down because the schools are unsafe.
sentences.zh: 但学校系统不会因为学校不安全而关闭。

sentences.en: Once we hit 3%, no matter what, the entire school system is going to shut down anyway, which is exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们达到3%，无论如何，整个学校系统无论如何都将关闭，而这正是发生的事情。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Eliza, at this point, the entire New York City public school system is virtual again.
sentences.zh: 那么，伊莉莎，此时此刻，整个纽约市公立学校系统又回到了虚拟教学状态。

sentences.en: Everyone's home.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在家。

sentences.en: Everyone's attending classes in front of a computer in their house.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在家里的电脑前上课。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, opening schools was so, so challenging.
sentences.zh: 我是说，开放学校是如此、如此具有挑战性。

sentences.en: And here we are, not two months later, and closing them down is really, really hard to do.
sentences.zh: 而现在，不到两个月后，关闭它们真的是非常、非常艰难。

sentences.en: I have heard just a lot of anguish from parents.
sentences.zh: 我听到了家长们大量的痛苦心声。

sentences.en: One mom who has a child with disabilities said their kid was lucky enough to go to school in person most days of the week, and it had been transformational.
sentences.zh: 一位有残疾儿童的母亲说，他们的孩子很幸运，一周中的大部分日子都可以去学校进行面授上课，这具有变革性的意义。

sentences.en: She felt like she was seeing the kid she knows come back to life after this period of sort of misery and frustration with remote learning.
sentences.zh: 她觉得在经历了远程学习带来的这种痛苦和沮丧之后，她看到了自己熟悉的那个孩子又重新焕发了生机。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: There's so much frustration and so much sadness, but there's also just so much confusion.
sentences.zh: 这里有太多的沮丧和悲伤，但也有太多的困惑。

sentences.en: I mean, we live in a city right now where the entire public school system is closed, but so much else is open.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们现在生活在这样一座城市里：整个公立学校系统都关闭了，但其他很多地方都开着。

sentences.en: I could go to dinner tonight indoors since it's kind of cold outside, but kids can't go to public schools.
sentences.zh: 由于外面有点冷，我今晚可以去室内吃晚餐，但孩子们却不能去公立学校。

sentences.en: I could go to the gym.
sentences.zh: 我可以去健身房。

sentences.en: I could get my nails done.
sentences.zh: 我可以去做美甲。

sentences.en: I could go to a museum.
sentences.zh: 我可以去博物馆。

sentences.en: That may not last long, but for right now, there's a lot you can do in New York that's open, and public schools are closed.
sentences.zh: 这可能不会持续太久，但就目前而言，在纽约有很多开放且你可以做的事，而公立学校却关门了。

sentences.en: That makes me curious.
sentences.zh: 这让我很好奇。

sentences.en: How are public health officials in the country reacting to the closure based on the 3% number?
sentences.zh: 国内的公共卫生官员对基于3%这个数字的关闭决定有何反应？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, a lot of them are saying it doesn't quite make sense to them either.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们中的许多人也表示这让他们觉得有些说不通。

sentences.en: I mean, you have Dr. Fauci recently, I mean, sort of the most trusted person in the country on coronavirus,
sentences.zh: 我是说，福奇博士最近——我是说，可以说是国内在冠状病毒问题上最受信任的人——

sentences.en: come out and say closing schools at that rate doesn't really make sense to him, that the default position should be to keep the schools open, he said, if you possibly can.
sentences.zh: 站出来说，以那个比率关闭学校对她来说真的说不通，他说，如果可能的话，默认立场应该是不惜一切代价让学校保持开放。

sentences.en: You know, we know that at least schools, elementary schools and schools for younger children, they're safer than certainly the worst fears.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们知道至少学校，小学和针对更小孩子的学校，它们比最糟糕的恐惧所设想的要安全得多。

sentences.en: And knowing all of that and hearing Dr. Fauci say, whatever you can do to keep the schools open, you should do.
sentences.zh: 了解了这一切，并听到福奇博士说，无论你能做什么来保持学校开放，你都应该去做。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it's just added to parents' frustration and rage and sort of exhaustion with this whole 3% thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为这只会加剧家长们对这整个3%事件的挫败感、愤怒以及某种精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's very clear that if not just parents, but Anthony Fauci himself are casting doubt on this number,
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，如果不仅是家长，就连安东尼·福奇本人都在对这个数字产生怀疑，

sentences.en: that everybody involved in coming up with that 3% figure needs to be asking themselves, did that ever make sense?
sentences.zh: 那么所有参与想出3%这个数字的人都需要扪心自问，这在当时真的合理吗？

sentences.en: Was that a mistake?
sentences.zh: 那是个错误吗？

sentences.en: I think what this whole 3% meltdown shows us is that decision-making in a pandemic, especially when it comes to kids, especially when it comes to schools,
sentences.zh: 我认为这场3%的崩盘向我们表明，在大流行期间做出决策，尤其是涉及到孩子、尤其是涉及到学校时，

sentences.en: it's actually never going to be based purely on the science.
sentences.zh: 它其实永远不可能完全建立在科学基础之上。

sentences.en: I mean, there is so much emotion and intensity and fear, rightfully.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这里面有着如此之多的情感、强烈情绪和恐惧，这是理所当然的。

sentences.en: These are children.
sentences.zh: 这些是孩子。

sentences.en: These are teachers.
sentences.zh: 这些是老师。

sentences.en: These are precious members of our society.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们社会中珍贵的成员。

sentences.en: There's so much fear and emotion around schools that it's really, really hard to make policy that doesn't have politics and PR as part of it.
sentences.zh: 围绕着学校有太多的恐惧和情感，以至于要制定一项不把政治和公关作为其中一部分的政策，真的是非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: It's very interesting what you just said.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说的话非常有趣。

sentences.en: It makes me wonder if the mayor himself, people around him in their heart of hearts, wish that they didn't have to abide by their own number here, this 3% rule.
sentences.zh: 这让我想知道市长本人以及他周围的人内心深处是否希望他们不必遵守自己定下的这个数字，即这个3%的规则。

sentences.en: Yes, I think the mayor is really frustrated and upset and sad that this day has come.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想市长对这一天的到来感到非常沮丧、心烦意乱和难过。

sentences.en: But I think what I'm understanding about the mayor's thinking right now is that he's thought, oh my God, what would it mean if I actually said, never mind, we have a new number.
sentences.zh: 但我想我对市长目前想法的理解是，他曾想，天哪，如果我真的说“算了，我们有一个新数字”，那会意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: Now it's 5, now it's 7, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 现在是5，现在是7，不管它是什么。

sentences.en: I think there is this deep feeling in the mayor's administration and with de Blasio himself that it would be a promise that he couldn't break.
sentences.zh: 我认为在市长政府内部以及德布拉西奥本人心中有一种根深蒂固的感觉，那就是这将是一个他无法打破的承诺。

sentences.en: He spent all summer talking about how this was a vow, this was a symbol.
sentences.zh: 他整个夏天都在谈论这是一个誓言，这是一个象征。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: And what I hear them saying is, and what would it say if we broke it, even though a lot of people want us to break it.
sentences.zh: 我听到他们说的是，如果我们打破它，哪怕很多人希望我们打破它，那又会说明什么呢？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯嗯。

sentences.en: But I think you have to remember the context in which we got to this dreaded 3% number.
sentences.zh: 但我想你必须记住我们陷入这个可怕的3%数字时的背景。

sentences.en: It was a moment in which breaking a promise like this would sort of be an unimaginable thing.
sentences.zh: 那是一个打破这样的承诺会成为一种难以想象的事情的时刻。

sentences.en: It would come off like a betrayal.
sentences.zh: 这会显得像是一种背叛。

sentences.en: And I think the mayor is still feeling really nervous about that.
sentences.zh: 我想市长对此仍然感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯嗯。

sentences.en: I mean, if you take us back to the worst days of March, people were begging the mayor to close the school system.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果你把我们带回三月份最糟糕的日子，人们当时在乞求市长关闭学校系统。

sentences.en: And he said, no, I'd act, you know, I want to keep it open as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 而他说，不，我会采取行动，你知道的，我想让它尽可能长时间地保持开放。

sentences.en: And in retrospect, the city kept the schools open too long.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，这座城市让学校开放的时间太长了。

sentences.en: And I think there is just a lot of regret and fear and anxiety about what if we ever left the school system open even a day too long.
sentences.zh: 我想对于“如果我们哪怕让学校系统多开放了一天会怎么样”，大家心中有着诸多的遗憾、恐惧和焦虑。

sentences.en: And what we're seeing now is decision-making, as was so much in this pandemic, that is really rooted in fear and regret and a profound sense of responsibility of,
sentences.zh: 而我们现在看到的是决策过程——就像这场大流行中的许多事情一样——它真正植根于恐惧、遗憾以及一种深刻的责任感，即：

sentences.en: I have to find a way to keep this city safe because New York was not a safe place just a few months ago.
sentences.zh: 我必须找到一种方法来保证这座城市的安全，因为就在几个月前，纽约还不是一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: So Eliza, what exactly happens now?
sentences.zh: 那么伊莉莎，现在究竟会发生什么？

sentences.en: When might New York City's public schools reopen?
sentences.zh: 纽约市的公立学校何时才能重新开学？

sentences.en: Is it as simple a question as the next time the seven-day rolling average dips below 3%?
sentences.zh: 这就像下一次七天滚动平均值降至3%以下这样一个简单的问题吗？

sentences.en: Is that the world we live in now?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在生活的世界吗？

sentences.en: We wait every day and check and see, has it finally dipped back below 3%?
sentences.zh: 我们每天都在等待、检查，看它是不是终于降回了3%以下？

sentences.en: So I think going forward, we're going to be talking a lot less about this 3% figure.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在未来，我们将大大减少对这个3%数字的讨论。

sentences.en: We actually don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上并不知道。

sentences.en: There isn't a plan right now for what it's going to take to reopen.
sentences.zh: 目前还没有重新开放的具体计划。

sentences.en: The mayor is, again, promising, making a promise that they will.
sentences.zh: 市长再次承诺，作出了他们会重开的承诺。

sentences.en: So we don't know what it's going to take.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道具体需要做到什么程度。

sentences.en: But I think the city now has to fight its way out of being tethered to this number that has caused so much frustration and anger and confusion.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这座城市现在必须摆脱对这个数字的束缚，这个数字已经引起了太多的挫败感、愤怒和困惑。

sentences.en: I think Bill de Blasio would, in a perfect world, never want to talk about 3% ever again.
sentences.zh: 我认为在理想情况下，比尔·德布拉西奥永远不想再谈论3%这个数字了。

sentences.en: And I'm sure public school parents wouldn't either.
sentences.zh: 而且我确信公立学校的家长们也不想。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm curious what you think the lessons are from the New York City public school system experience for school systems around the rest of the country.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你认为纽约市公立学校系统的经验对全美其他地区的学校系统有什么启示？

sentences.en: Is the lesson don't open until the pandemic is really over so you don't get into this position?
sentences.zh: 经验是等到疫情真正结束再开放，以免陷入这种境地吗？

sentences.en: Is the lesson open but don't do it with a 3% number?
sentences.zh: 经验是开放，但不要用3%这个数字吗？

sentences.en: What's the lesson?
sentences.zh: 启示到底是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think, you know, don't ever open until we're all vaccinated is probably not going to be good enough for a lot of kids and families in America.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为，你知道，等到我们所有人都接种疫苗再开放，对美国许多孩子和家庭来说可能远远不够。

sentences.en: And the reality is, I mean, we've learned this over and over in this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，我的意思是，我们在这次疫情中一次又一次地学到了这一点。

sentences.en: This is what school opening is going to look like.
sentences.zh: 这就是学校开放时的样子。

sentences.en: You're going to be open for a bit and then you're going to close.
sentences.zh: 你会开放一段时间，然后又会关闭。

sentences.en: And there's going to be a cycle of that because there is no consistency in this moment.
sentences.zh: 这种循环将会持续下去，因为在这个时刻没有任何连贯性。

sentences.en: And that doesn't mean that we shouldn't try to have kids learn in person.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着我们不应该尝试让孩子们进行线下学习。

sentences.en: But what it does mean is that you have to have a really good plan for both.
sentences.zh: 但它的确意味着，你必须为这两种情况都制定一个非常好的计划。

sentences.en: You have to have a good entry strategy and a good exit strategy or else all of your work to get kids in there in the first place.
sentences.zh: 你必须有一个好的进入策略和一个好的退出策略，否则你为了让孩子们去学校所做的一切努力。

sentences.en: It just doesn't mean as much anymore.
sentences.zh: 就变得毫无意义了。

sentences.en: Thank you, Eliza.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，伊丽莎。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Pennsylvania is set to certify President-elect Joe Biden's victory there on Monday.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州将于周一在该州正式确认当选总统乔·拜登的胜利。

sentences.en: A lawsuit filed by the Trump campaign, which baselessly alleged widespread problems with mail-in ballots in Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选团队提起的一起诉讼毫无根据地指称宾夕法尼亚州的邮寄选票存在广泛问题，

sentences.en: was dismissed on Saturday by a federal judge who said that it lacked evidence.
sentences.zh: 周六被一名联邦法官驳回，法官称该诉讼缺乏证据。

sentences.en: Soon after, Pennsylvania Senator Pat Toomey, a Republican, declared that Trump had, quote,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，共和党籍的宾夕法尼亚州参议员帕特·图米宣布，特朗普已经，引述，

sentences.en: exhausted all plausible legal options in the state and congratulated Biden on his victory.
sentences.zh: 用尽了在该州所有合理的法律途径，并祝贺拜登获胜。

sentences.en: And Biden will begin announcing members of his cabinet starting tomorrow, putting the pace of Biden's transition ahead of Trump's from four years ago.
sentences.zh: 拜登将于明天开始宣布其内阁成员名单，这使得拜登过渡团队的进展领先于四年前的特朗普。

sentences.en: Obviously, this is not going to be the same kind of inauguration we've had in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 显然，这不会是与我们过去经历过的那种相同的就职典礼。

sentences.en: In an interview with ABC on Sunday, Biden's incoming chief of staff, Ron Klain, said that planning for the inauguration was well underway,
sentences.zh: 周日，拜登即将上任的白宫办公厅主任罗恩·克莱恩在接受美国广播公司采访时表示，就职典礼的筹备工作正在顺利进行，

sentences.en: but acknowledged that it would be a different kind of ceremony given the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但也承认，鉴这将是一场不同的典礼，考虑到疫情。

sentences.en: We know people want to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 我们知道人们想要庆祝。

sentences.en: There is something here to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 这里确实有值得庆祝的事情。

sentences.en: We just want to try to find a way to do it as safely as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想设法尽可能安全地进行庆祝。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在您喜欢的任何地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
